seo.title: aiCALL — Georgian calls that confirm bookings and show the outcome
seo.description: aiCALL calls a business's own customers about existing appointments, deliveries or payments. It asks one short question in Georgian, records the outcome and hands uncertain calls to a person. Marketing calls need written consent.

hero.commitment: aiNOW checks your list, script, consent basis and human handoff before a campaign starts. You approve the setup and keep the outcome sheet.
hero.audience: For clinics, service businesses, salons, delivery teams and administrators
hero.sub: aiCALL calls your own customers before a booked appointment or delivery, asks a short question in Georgian and marks each response. Missed confirmations become a visible list your team can act on.
hero.signedBy: aiNOW configures the call, checks the handoff and shows the result before you decide what comes next.

work.headingAccent: From an approved list to a visible outcome.
work.s1Title: Send the customers you already serve
work.s1Desc: Use the list your team already works with. aiNOW checks that each call concerns an existing appointment, order or agreement before anything starts.
work.s2Desc: Set the opening, the confirmation question and the point where a person takes over. The agent follows the approved wording and does not improvise.

work.s5Desc: Confirmed, rescheduled, no answer or human follow-up. Your team sees the next action without listening to every call.
work.s6Desc: Your team approves the list and script, handles exceptions and decides what happens after the outcome is recorded.

faq.subtitle: What the call can do, when a person steps in, and where consent sets the boundary.
faq.a1: The demo uses a short, fixed Georgian question because that is the reliable business task. Listen to the sample here. aiNOW tests your wording before launch and sends open questions to a person.
faq.q2: Will customers know that an AI agent is calling?
faq.a2: Yes. The opening identifies the AI agent and your business. aiNOW checks the final wording with you. If your sector needs another disclosure, the campaign pauses until it is cleared.
faq.q3: Can aiCALL use a bought or scraped number list?
faq.a3: No. aiNOW does not start from a bought or scraped list. Direct marketing requires written consent under Georgian law. If ownership or consent is unclear, the list pauses for review.
faq.q4: Which calls may be suitable without marketing consent?
faq.a4: Operational calls to your own customers about an existing appointment, order or agreement may be suitable. Selling something new is marketing and needs written consent. This consent check is guidance, not legal advice.
faq.q5: What happens when the customer asks an open question?
faq.a5: The agent stops the fixed script and hands the call to a person, or marks a follow-up for your team. It does not invent an answer.
faq.q6: Can the call move to a real employee?
faq.a6: Yes. You choose the handoff number and the situations that require a person. The employee receives the customer while the context is still clear.
faq.a7: Cost depends on the approved list size and planned call length. The calculator uses your inputs. aiNOW provides a written quote after reviewing the scenario.
faq.q8: What is needed before a test starts?
faq.a8: aiNOW needs the approved list, short script, consent basis and handoff number. The start date is agreed only after those checks are complete.
faq.q9: What if the customer does not answer?
faq.a9: The agreed retry rule applies. After the final attempt, the outcome becomes no answer and your employee decides whether another follow-up is appropriate.
faq.q10: Can aiCALL use our spreadsheet or booking system?
faq.a10: Excel and Google Sheets can provide the call list. aiNOW reviews an existing booking system before confirming any connection to it.
faq.q11: Can the same flow use Russian or English?
faq.a11: The flow can be configured for Georgian, Russian and English. Your team approves each language's script and sample separately before calls begin.
faq.q12: What answer rate should we expect?
faq.a12: aiNOW does not publish a borrowed answer rate as your result. The outcome board shows what will be measured on your approved campaign without presenting this demo as customer data.
faq.q13: Can it remind customers about a payment?
faq.a13: A reminder tied to an existing agreement can be reviewed. A dispute, new offer or payment question goes to a person. aiCALL does not collect card details by phone.
faq.q14: What is the difference between aiCALL, aiSTAFF and aiOFFICE?
faq.a14: aiCALL handles approved phone calls. aiSTAFF handles customer messages. aiOFFICE supports internal documents and approvals. aiNOW helps you choose the product that matches the work.

consent.heading: Check the list before any campaign starts.
consent.subtitle: Answer all three questions yourself. aiCALL never fills them in for you.
consent.q1yes: Yes, they booked, ordered or signed with us
consent.q1no: No, the list was bought, shared or collected elsewhere
consent.q2: Is the call only about their existing relationship with you?
consent.q2yes: Yes, an appointment, order or current agreement
consent.q2no: No, we want to offer something new
consent.q3: Do you hold written consent for marketing calls?
consent.q3yes: Yes, the written record is available
consent.q3no: No, or the record is uncertain
consent.greenBody: These are your own customers and the call concerns an existing appointment, order or agreement. aiNOW can prepare an operational script after the details are checked.
consent.amberBody: One answer changes the legal basis. Do not start the campaign yet. aiNOW separates operational calls from marketing and asks you to confirm the written record.
consent.redBody: The list is not yours and no written marketing consent is recorded. aiNOW will not start calls from it.
consent.law: Georgia's Law on Personal Data Protection sets rules for direct marketing, including written consent and handling objections within seven working days.
consent.notice: This check is practical guidance, not legal advice. If the facts are unclear, aiNOW pauses the campaign and asks for a legal review.

board.heading: See the outcome of every call.
board.subtitle: This is a fixed product demonstration, not customer data. It shows how 100 sample calls move into four action queues.
board.note: Example only. Your board will use your approved list and actual call outcomes.

barge.heading: The customer can stop the script.
barge.subtitle: Watch the agent stop, acknowledge the interruption, offer a next step and mark the outcome. Press Interrupt to try it yourself.
barge.recovery: Understood. When should a person call you back?
barge.note: The agent does not argue or guess. A changed request becomes a clear task for your employee.

cost.heading: Put your current call work into numbers.
cost.subtitle: The sample moves until you touch a slider. Your first change stops it, and aiCALL never replaces your values.
cost.note: The aiCALL amount uses aiNOW's planning rate for this example. The list size, call length and staff cost come from your sliders.
